newsitem.title: EGYPT: Five killed in illegal fireworks factory in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in illegal fireworks factory in Egypt.

text.p: Five people were killed on Friday in an explosion in a Cairo flat where they making firecrackers, security sources said.
The explosion set fire to the flat and the bodies were completely charred when the fire brigade arrived.
The illegal fireworks factory violated health and safety regulations, the sources said.
